name: One and Only
source: The protagonist is a popular guy. However, no-one has asked him out. When he was a child, an accident meant he had to move away. But he made a promise to a childhood friend. "I'll definitely return to this street." That was 10 years ago, and he has been waiting day after day to return to the girl...
translation: 主人公很受欢迎，却从来没有人向他告白。小时候的一场事故迫使他搬离故乡，但他曾与青梅竹马许下约定：“我一定会回到这条街。”那已经是十年前的事了。日复一日，他始终等待着回到那个女孩身边……
